text:
Type: geometric wool runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: contemporary, bohemian, modern
Materials: wool, multicolored flecked weave
Colors: ivory, red, purple, flecks of blue and yellow
Shape: long narrow runner, concentric star and diamond chevron pattern, speckled texture, flat low pile, light visual weight
Feel: lively, playful, warm
Goes with: dark wood floors, white walls, colorful accents; eclectic or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geometric Wool Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Ivory, Red, Purple
product.description: Red and purple geometrics on ivory combine influences of Southwestern and modern, providing an eye-catching centerpiece for your hallway. The hand-tufted wool blend is soft, while the pile height makes it easy to maintain and slide under furniture. 2' 6" x 8' with medium 0.3" pile Easy to maintain and fits well under furniture Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
